description: This file defines an interface 'RuntimeLoaderInterface' within the Twig templating engine, specifying a method for creating runtime implementations of Twig elements.

classes.name: RuntimeLoaderInterface
classes.description: An interface for creating runtime implementations for Twig elements such as filters, functions, and tests.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Creates the runtime implementation of a Twig element (filter, function, or test). Returns an object instance or null if unable to create.
